# DIFFERNTIAL EXPRESSION AND PATHWAY ENRICHMENT ANALYSIS OF BASIC CLUSTERS

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(ReactomePA)
library(enrichplot)
library(stringr)
library(presto)
```

### to avoid the overwhelming signal of product cells, these will be excluded
```{r}
Idents(catcar) <- "Timepoint_bin"
no_product <- subset(catcar, idents = c("Early", "Mid", "Late"))
```

### run findallmarkers to find the unique signature of the reamining clusters
### to speed things up, will parallelise by running future.apply
```{r}
Idents(no_product) <- "basic_clusters"
idents <- levels(Idents(no_product))

markers <- lapply(idents, function(x) {
  FindMarkers(
    object = no_product,
    ident.1 = x,
    test.use = "wilcox",
    min.pct = 0.1
  )
})
```


```{r}
degs <- read.csv("basic_clusters_degs.csv")
c1_degs <- filter(degs, cluster == "c1")
c1_degs <- filter(c1_degs, p_val_adj < 0.05)
```

```{r}
genes <- c1_degs$gene

go_enrich <- enrichGO(
    gene = genes,
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
    keyType = "SYMBOL"
)
```

```{r}
enriched_pathways <- go_enrich@result
enriched_pathways <- filter(enriched_pathways, qvalue < 0.05)
```

```{r}
gene_conv <- bitr(
    c1_degs$gene,
    fromType = "SYMBOL",
    toType = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
)

reactome_enrich <- enrichPathway(gene=gene_conv$ENTREZID, pvalueCutoff = 0.05, readable = T)
```
```{r}
react_pathways <- reactome_enrich@result
react_pathways <- filter(react_pathways, p.adjust < 0.05)
```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(react_pathways, aes( x = zScore, y = reorder(Description, zScore), fill = p.adjust))+geom_col()+theme_bw()+scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Reds")+theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"))+ylab(NULL)+
     scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 50))
p
ggsave(plot = p, filename = "cluster1_reactome_pathways.png", dpi = 300, height = 8, width = 8)
```
